extracted_text:
From: pharmacovigilance@globalpharma.com
To: safety@clinicverse.com
Subject: Adverse Event Report - Anaphylaxis to Amoxicillin
Date: 2025-08-28T16:30:00Z

INDIVIDUAL CASE SAFETY REPORT (ICSR)

Report ID: AE-2025-2847
Report Type: Initial
Date of Report: 2025-08-28

Patient Information:
Name: Elena Rodriguez (pseudonym)
DOB: 11/08/1982
Sex: Female
Weight: 62 kg
Height: 165 cm

Medical History:
- Penicillin allergy (childhood, details unknown)
- No other known allergies

Event Description:
Patient developed anaphylaxis approximately 15 minutes after receiving first oral dose of Amoxicillin 500mg for dental prophylaxis.

Symptoms:
- Immediate onset urticaria (widespread)
- Angioedema of lips and tongue
- Bronchospasm
- Hypotension (BP dropped from 120/80 to 85/50)
- Tachycardia (HR 110 bpm)

Product Information:
Drug: Amoxicillin
Manufacturer: Global Pharma Inc.
Lot: GP-AMX-2025-112
NDC: 98765-432-10
Dose: 500mg oral
Route: Oral
Indication: Dental prophylaxis

Treatment of Event:
- Epinephrine 0.3mg IM administered immediately
- Diphenhydramine 50mg IV
- Methylprednisolone 125mg IV
- Normal saline 1L IV bolus
- Supplemental oxygen

Outcome: Recovered with sequelae (respiratory symptoms resolved within 4 hours, mild fatigue persisted for 3 days)

Reporter: Dr. Michael Chen, DDS
Facility: Bright Smile Dental Clinic
Contact: dr.chen@brightsmile-dental.com
